Subject: MAP pricing ask (Finexa) — internal 

Team,

Finexa has requested a 35% discount + $15k one-time credit on an estimated $120k commit (12mo). They want a quick path to sign by 11/30. Key constraints: Dedicated GPU capacity for their latency-sensitive flows and guarantees on throughput for production (they will likely move to Redwood Dedicated after POC).

My recommended counter (balancing win probability and unit economics):
- Discount: 25% off list
- One-time credit: $10,000 (applied to migration/integration services)
- Commit: 12 months minimum, prefer 18 months at $150k ARR to justify capacity reservation
- Add: SLA and latency acceptance criteria in the SOW (Grace to validate technical thresholds)

Ask:
- Marissa: can we pre-approve the $10k credit from deal desk for a >$140k commit?
- Karthik: do we need VP signoff for 25% on this account?
- Grace: can you run a short latency profile and confirm if our Dedicated sizing assumptions (2x A100 for initial ramp) hold?

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft pricing buckets & scenarios). I will present the above in the external meeting on 11/06 unless you flag changes.

Thanks,
Rafael
